title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins is swept into a quest to reclaim the dwarves' mountain home from the dragon Smaug, discovering courage he never knew he had.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: Kvothe, a legendary figure living in obscurity, recounts how a gifted orphan became the most notorious wizard his world has ever seen.

title: A Game of Thrones
author: George R.R. Martin
description: Noble families vie for the Iron Throne of Westeros while an ancient darkness stirs beyond the Wall in this epic of intrigue and betrayal.

title: The Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: On the storm-ravaged world of Roshar, a soldier, a scholar, and a highprince are drawn toward the secrets of the ancient Knights Radiant.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Paul Atreides inherits a desert planet that is the sole source of the most precious substance in the universe, and a destiny larger than empires.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: A lone astronaut wakes with no memory aboard a ship far from home, tasked with saving Earth — and finds the most unlikely ally imaginable.

title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
description: Child prodigy Ender Wiggin is drafted into an orbital battle school where war games and reality blur in humanity's fight for survival.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: Stranded alone on Mars, astronaut Mark Watney refuses to die, engineering his survival one impossible problem at a time.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
description: A disgraced journalist and a brilliant hacker untangle a decades-old disappearance rooted in one of Sweden's wealthiest families.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: On their fifth wedding anniversary, Amy Dunne vanishes — and every clue points to her husband, whose version of the marriage keeps shifting.

title: The Da Vinci Code
author: Dan Brown
description: A murder in the Louvre pulls symbologist Robert Langdon into a race across Europe to decode a secret guarded for two thousand years.

title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
description: Ten strangers are lured to an isolated island, where an unseen host begins killing them one by one according to a sinister nursery rhyme.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet spars with the proud Mr. Darcy in a sparkling comedy of manners about first impressions and second chances.

title: The Notebook
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: Noah reads to Allie from a worn notebook, retelling the summer romance that defined their lives and refuses to be forgotten.

title: Me Before You
author: Jojo Moyes
description: Louisa Clark takes a job caring for the paralyzed Will Traynor, and the two remake each other's ideas of what a life worth living means.

title: Outlander
author: Diana Gabaldon
description: Wartime nurse Claire Randall touches an ancient stone circle and is thrown two centuries back into the dangerous Scottish Highlands of 1743.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: From the cognitive revolution to the age of algorithms, a sweeping account of how one species came to rule the planet.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical framework for building good habits and breaking bad ones through tiny changes that compound into remarkable results.

title: Educated
author: Tara Westover
description: Raised in a survivalist family that kept her out of school, Tara Westover fights her way to a PhD — and reckons with what education costs.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman maps the two systems that drive the way we think, and the biases that quietly steer our judgment.

author: George Orwell
description: In a state where Big Brother watches everything, Winston Smith commits the gravest crime of all: thinking for himself.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: Through Scout Finch's eyes, a small Alabama town confronts its conscience when her father defends a Black man falsely accused of a crime.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Jay Gatsby throws glittering parties for one impossible dream in Fitzgerald's brief, perfect elegy for the American Dream.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
description: Seven generations of the Buendía family rise and fall in Macondo, in the novel that defined magical realism.
